title: Seat Growth Adjustment on ClearPath Renewal Rates
content:
The seat-growth adjustment of the renewal rate on an automatic renewal of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement compares the covered seats on the seat ledger (every seat addition less every seat removal) with the agreement's contracted seats. The adjustment is a percentage taken off the renewal rate.

**Graduated scale.**
- Each covered seat from the first that is at least 10 percent above the contracted seats earns 0.5 percent.
- Each covered seat from the first that is at least 25 percent above the contracted seats earns 1.0 percent instead.
- The earned percentages are summed and divided by the covered seats to give the percentage taken off.
- With no covered seat that far above the contracted seats, nothing is taken off.

The first seat at least 10 percent above is the seat whose number is the contracted seats increased by 10 percent, rounded up to a whole seat; likewise for 25 percent.

**Hypothetical worked cases, 40 contracted seats.** The first seat at least 10 percent above is seat 44; the first at least 25 percent above is seat 50.

| Covered seats on the ledger | Seats earning 0.5 | Seats earning 1.0 | Percentage taken off |
|---|---|---|---|
| 43 | none | none | nothing |
| 44 | seat 44 | none | 0.5 divided by 44, about 0.0114 percent |
| 46 | seats 44 to 46 (3) | none | 1.5 divided by 46, about 0.0326 percent |
| 52 | seats 44 to 49 (6) | seats 50 to 52 (3) | 3.0 plus 3.0, that is 6.0, divided by 52, about 0.1154 percent |

With 30 contracted seats, 33 seats is exactly 10 percent above and earns the 0.5 rate from seat 33; 37.5 rounds up to 38, so 1.0 applies from seat 38.
